statements: Running our company vehicles and drivers
Keeping track of company cars, vans and trucks, their drivers, trips, fuel use and accessories, plus driver behaviour and compliance reminders.
We run a fleet of vans and cars and track them outside BC.
Fuel receipts and trip sheets are typed in by hand.
We cannot see the fuel consumption per vehicle.
We want to know which equipment and accessories sit in which vehicle.
We need to see where our vehicles are and how drivers drive.
Drivers forget inspections and document renewals unless someone reminds them.
We want vehicle running costs next to the asset in the books.
